title: Honey, I Shrunk the Kids
about: A scientist accidentally shrinks his kids and the neighbours' kids to the size of ants.
cue: Serve the snacks when the kids ride the ant.

    StartersGiant puffed rice cereal ringMarshmallow puffed rice treat pressed in a ring mould, cut into wedgesHow to make it60g butter250g marshmallows150g puffed rice cerealMelt the butter with the marshmallows over low heat.Stir through the puffed rice until coated.Press firmly into a greased ring mould.Set, then turn out and cut into wedges at the table.Backyard toy brick jelly blocksThe backyard toy that becomes a shelterHow to make itAs written, serves 4Firm, bright fruit jelly blocks in red, yellow and blue, cut into bricks with little cream studs piped on top, ready to stack.Make 3 packets of different coloured jelly, each with half the usual water (about 250ml boiling water) plus 2 tsp extra powdered gelatine, so they set firm.Pour each into a separate lined 20cm square tin and chill 4 hours.Cut into 2 by 4cm bricks.Whip 150ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and pipe two rows of small dots on each brick as studs.Ants on a logIn memory of Antie, who got them home.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsGiant pancakesOne big buttermilk pancake cut into wedges, butter and maple syrupHow to make it300g plain flour2 tsp baking powder2 tbsp caster sugar500ml buttermilk2 eggs60g butter120ml maple syrupWhisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, buttermilk and eggs into a batter.Pour into a large buttered pan over low heat, cover and cook.Flip with a plate and cook the other side. Repeat for the remaining batter.Cut into wedges with butter and maple syrup.Szalinski backyard burgers and cornDodge the lawn mowerHow to make itAs written, serves 4Juicy beef burgers grilled over coals with melted cheese, lettuce and tomato on toasted buns, with buttered corn on the cob and a crunchy green salad.Mix 800g beef mince with salt and pepper and shape into 4 patties.Grill over hot coals 4 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheese to each for the last minute.Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes, turning, and brush with butter.Toss cos lettuce, cucumber and cherry tomatoes with a dressing of 3 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp vinegar and 1 tsp mustard.Toast 4 buns and fill with lettuce, tomato, patty and sauce.SweetsBackyard s'moresToasted marshmallow and milk chocolate squashed between plain cookiesHow to make it16 large marshmallows32 plain biscuits200g milk chocolateToast the marshmallows on skewers over a gas flame or under the grill until golden.Squash each between two biscuits with a square of chocolate.Leave briefly so the chocolate melts.Giant cream cookieTwo big dark chocolate cookies filled with vanilla buttercreamHow to make it100g butter, soft200g icing sugar1 tsp vanilla extract2 large dark chocolate cookies (about 20cm across)Beat the butter, icing sugar and vanilla until fluffy.Spread thickly over one dark chocolate cookie and sandwich with the other, pressing gently.Chill, then cut into wedges.DrinksSprinkler watermelon pink lemonadeFresh watermelon and lemon juice topped with soda water, no alcoholHow to make it800g seedless watermelon chunks4 lemons80ml sugar syrup400ml soda water1 bunch mint1 bag iceBlitz the watermelon until smooth and strain into a jug.Stir in the juice of the lemons and the sugar syrup.Fill four tall glasses with ice, pour the mix two thirds of the way and top with soda water.Garnish with lemon wheels and mint.Iced chocolate milkBig Russ is mowing.
